title: Files
description: A file manager, a file viewer, a text editor and a CSV table in one docked sidebar, in the terminal and the desktop app: a folder tree kept up to date as files change, copy, move, Trash and undo for several files at once, Git's own markers and what the agent changed, search through the folder, and an editor that will not write over a file someone else changed

settings.label: Panel width (% of the window)
settings.desc: The sidebar's share of the window; the editor takes a little more

settings.label: File tree
settings.desc: With a file open beside it, which side the tree takes: left, as editors have it, or right, at the window's edge

settings.label: Text editor
settings.desc: In a terminal, where a text file opens: the panel's own editor, or Neovim, Vim or the command below in a terminal panel beside it (E in the tree is always the built-in one). The desktop app always uses its own editor

settings.label: Editor command (custom)
settings.desc: With Text editor set to custom: the command, {file} and {line} filled in, e.g. hx {file}:{line} or micro +{line} {file}

settings.label: HTML files open as
settings.desc: In the desktop app: page, the file drawn by the browser that is installed (Firefox or a Chromium, run without a window, in a profile of its own) with its styles and scripts; reader, its content read by the plugin, which loads nothing from the web until you say so

settings.label: Preview size limit (KB)
settings.desc: How much of a file the preview reads; a bigger file is shown in part

settings.label: Mark the files the agent changed
settings.desc: Badge the files this session wrote, in the tree and in the Changed tab you can press

settings.label: Show Git's markers
settings.desc: Mark the tree with what git status thinks of each file (M, ?, A, …). The patch itself stays /diff's job

settings.label: Keep up with the agent
settings.desc: After each tool call, re-read what the core changed and say when a file you are looking at moved under you

settings.label: Follow the agent
settings.desc: Open each file the agent writes as it writes it (F in the tree, or the Follow button, switches it for now)

settings.label: Open files named in the chat
settings.desc: Under each reply in the desktop app, the files it names as chips that open them in the panel; and a line asking the agent to write paths as path:line

settings.label: Terminal look
settings.desc: drawn: the panel's own lines, in the colorscheme's colors (the file beside the tree, a selection, the mouse); elements: the shared elements, which a TUI library can restyle
